tests.title: Dashboard numbers match the templates' contacts and replies
tests.goal: The 儀表板 cards (本月已發送, 本月發送失敗, 回覆率, 總聯繫人數, 總模板數) and the 模板審核狀態 table show the same numbers as the templates themselves.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)
At least one approved template with sent contacts, one failed contact and one reply this month

steps.text: Note per template: contacts, sent this month, failed this month, replies (from the contacts page and 回覆統計)

expected.text: 本月已發送, 本月發送失敗, 總聯繫人數 and 總模板數 equal the sums of step 1
回覆率 = replies ÷ sent, counting only templates with 是否需要回覆 = 是
模板審核狀態 lists each template with its status, 是否需要回覆, 聯絡人 and 回覆數 matching step 1

notes: QA admin: cards 本月已發送 0, 總聯繫人數 1, 總模板數 1, 回覆率 N/A, but 模板審核狀態 lists 5 templates incl. qa_event_reminder_357859 sent 29 Oct with 1 reply. Table per-template counts (聯絡人, 回覆數) match the templates. DB-only template qa_legacy_909191 is counted in the cards but not listed in the table.

tests.title: Dashboard covers every template the user's role can see
tests.goal: Admins, editors and viewers see dashboard totals and message records for every template, as the intended roles say (context.md, product owner 2026-10-29).
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)
A template created by admin@tungwah.org with contacts, and a QA admin, a QA editor and a QA viewer (created per test, deleted afterwards)

steps.text: Log in as each QA user and open 儀表板
Compare 總模板數, 總聯繫人數 and 消息記錄 with admin@tungwah.org's dashboard

expected.text: Each role sees the same totals and records for all templates

notes: QA admin sees only its own template in cards and 消息記錄; filtering by qa_event_reminder_357859 gives 暫無記錄. QA editor and QA viewer (created and deleted): all cards 0, empty status table, 0 records.

tests.title: Dashboard message records filter, search and page correctly
tests.goal: 消息記錄 shows the right contacts for each filter, search and page.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)
More than 50 contacts across two templates, with sent, failed and pending statuses (e.g. data/contacts-1000-rows.xlsx on a draft template, no send)

steps.text: Open 儀表板 > 消息記錄
Filter by one template, then by each 狀態
Search a name, then part of a phone number

expected.text: 共 N 筆 matches the filtered count; each page shows up to 50 rows without repeats or gaps
Failed rows show the error 代碼 and 備註
Filters and search can be combined and cleared

notes: 1000 contacts appended to qa_legacy_909191 (no send, removed afterwards). 共 1001 筆, 21 pages of 50; Bulk 0499 on page 10 and 11, Bulk 0999 never listed. Search by name, partial and full phone works; phone with spaces finds nothing; PENDING filter correct; ?status=bogus returns 500 (API only). Sent/failed rows and error 代碼 not checkable: no sent contacts visible to the QA admin (BUG-041).

tests.title: Opening the dashboard does not change or delete data
tests.goal: Just viewing 儀表板 does not change templates, contacts or replies, for any role.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)
A template with contacts and replies; a QA viewer (created per test, deleted afterwards)

steps.text: Note templates, contacts and reply counts
Open 儀表板 as admin, then as the QA viewer

expected.text: Nothing changed; a viewer's visit writes nothing
Status updates from Twilio are the only changes, and no template or reply is removed

notes: Admin load: nothing deleted (all synced templates still in Twilio). Viewer load: sync returned [] but all 5 synced templates were upserted (updatedAt changed). Values unchanged this time since Twilio and app matched.
